# Fe/male Switch

> > Fe/male Switch is a women-first startup game and online incubator combining gamification, AI co-founders, and blockchain technology to democratize entrepreneurship education for female founders.

Fe/male Switch is a non-profit RPG simulator and startup school designed to empower women entrepreneurs with AI-powered tools, gamified learning, and community support. The platform combines startup education, a business simulation game, skill development labs, and a global portfolio of female-led startups.

- Fe/male Switch (F/MS)

## Core Platform

- [Fe/male Switch: Startup Game for Women Entrepreneurs](https://femaleswitch.com): Online incubator & startup game for women entrepreneurs with AI co-founder PlayPal
- [Fe/male Switch (F/MS): RPG & Simulator for Future Gamepreneurs](https://femaleswitch.com/our-company): Non-profit RPG simulator for gamepreneurs using blockchain, LLMs, and gamification
- [Women-First Startup Game: Discover More About Our Platform](https://femaleswitch.com/inside-platform): Platform overview: startup game mechanics, Skill Lab, Marketplace, Wallet, and team building
- [The Future of F/MS Startup in The Metaverse](https://femaleswitch.com/metaverse): F/MS metaverse vision: virtual community platform using Spatial.io, Blender, and VR technology

## Startup Education & Training

- [F/MS Free Startup School](https://femaleswitch.com/free-startup-school): Free startup education for women: build startups without technical skills, funding, or leaving your job
- [Fe/male Switch Services: What We Do Best](https://femaleswitch.com/services): Fe/male Switch services: entrepreneurship education, certifications, hackathons, networking events
- [Startup Playbook: Behind the Scenes of Tech Startups](https://femaleswitch.com/playbook): Startup success strategies, tips, and industry insights for female entrepreneurs and business growth
- [TOP Female Business Ideas in 2025 | F/MS Female Business Ideas](https://femalebusinessideas2025.femaleswitch.com): 2025 business ideas for female entrepreneurs: low-investment, side businesses, AI coaching with PlayPal

## AI Tools & Co-Founders

- [Empower Your Startup Journey with AI Co-Founder & Startup Tools](https://femaleswitch.com/ai-startup-tools): AI startup tools & co-founders (Elona, Annie, Aiden, Boris) for business planning and pitch decks
- [Joke Generator by Elona Musk](https://femaleswitch.com/startup-humor): Free AI joke generator tool by Elona for startup humor and stress relief
